## Flagship Open-Source Projects
- [SLASH](https://github.com/1nsharma/SLASH): Unified URL (Urlmind), GitHub Repository, and API/DB Schema intelligence engine that maps fragmented codebases into a 4-zone architecture graph and runnable application bundle.
- [SlashGraph](https://github.com/1nsharma-labs/slashgraph): Zero-token AST & web intelligence graph with a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop and Cursor.
- [DukaanMitra / MitraOS](https://github.com/1nsharma/Dukaanmitra-MitraOS): Event-driven, WhatsApp-first CRM and deterministic accounting ledger for Indian SMB merchants without recurring cloud SaaS bloat.
- [DevDaemon](https://github.com/1nsharma-labs/devdaemon): Terminal error interceptor, zombie port killer, and shell diagnostics MCP connector.
- [TokenArmor](https://github.com/1nsharma-labs/tokenarmor): Open-source AI gateway and LLM token FinOps firewall with caching, hard budget caps, and PII masking.

## Services & Commercial Capabilities
- Custom AI automation pipelines (self-hosted n8n, Ollama, MCP servers)
